text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a spike in kv_evictions_total but no labels. Hard to tell if this is age-driven evictions vs memory_pressure vs compaction. Can we add a low-cardinality eviction_reason label + a small reuse heatmap by session length? cc @aj @sami
aj: Agree. Right now we only have kv_evictions_total and kv_residency_percent. Adding labels might blow up cardinality — need to design carefully (low cardinality + optional emission).
sami: What about enumerated reasons (age|mem_pressure|compaction|manual|unknown) and only tag on the eviction metric itself, not on every residency sample? That keeps series limited.
maria: Exactly. Also want a kv_reuse_heatmap: x-axis session length buckets (0-128,128-512,512-1024,1024+), y-axis reuse-count bins. Should help debug long-context memory growth and fragmentation -> eviction correlation.
aj: PromQL sketches: sum by(reason) (increase(kv_evictions_total[5m])) for short term; for heatmap, either histogram buckets or a bucketed counter exported from runtime. histogram_quantile won't compose well if we need 2D heatmap.
sami: Example exporter change (pseudo):
```
counter "kv_evictions_total" {label: "shard"} -> increment(reason="age")
# keep reason as enum, default "unknown"
// avoid adding dynamic labels like session_id
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for new metrics exporter on infra-eviction-canary (3 nodes).
aj: Also ran a perf profile yesterday — when eviction spikes, kernel-selection loop shows ~30-50ms stalls per selection iteration. Hypothesis: page reclaim / compaction is serializing a hot lock the kernel selector hits when loading quantized kernels.
maria: That matches traces we saw in prod during long-chat sessions. If eviction triggers compaction it stalls runtime threads and increases latency tail. We should instrument timing around kernel selection and page reclaim separately.
sami: Agreed — propose 3 new Grafana dashboards/panels: 1) eviction_by_reason (stacked area, 1m) 2) kv_reuse_heatmap (session_len_bucket x reuse_count bins) 3) kernel_selection_latency correlated with eviction_rate and page_reclaim_ops.
aj: I'll draft the PromQL + panels. Plan: change exporter to emit reason label (enum), canary for 48h, collect cardinality metrics. If stable, roll to prod and add dashboards + alerts. Assigning to @aj (dash + PromQL) and @sami (exporter + tests). :memo: :eyes:
maria: :+1: Add the PromQL you plan and I'll review alert thresholds. For alerts: trigger if age evictions > 10/min AND kernel_selection_p50 increases by >20ms over baseline.
aj: PromQL examples (draft):
```
# eviction counts by reason
sum by(reason) (increase(kv_evictions_total[5m]))

# residency p50/p95 by session length bucket (requires exporter to tag bucket)
sum by(session_len_bucket) (histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(session_len_bucket, le) (rate(kv_residency_bucket[5m]))))

# heatmap source: kv_reuse_bucket{session_len_bucket="128-512", reuse_bin="2-4"}
# kernel selection latency correlated with eviction rate (5m)
avg_over_time(kernel_selection_ms[5m]) / (sum(increase(kv_evictions_total[5m])) + 1)
```
sami: On cardinality: exporters should always emit reason (enum) even if unknown; do NOT include fine-grained labels like caller_id or session_id. Also limit shards labeled to coarse shard groups (e.g., shard_group=hot|cold) to reduce series.
maria: Good call. Use 'unknown' for reason when not set. I'll update the ops runbook to check kernel-selection stalls when age evictions > 10/min. Thanks — let's reconvene after 48h canary.
